facts.fact: HISP Rwanda reports that a high-level meeting on 15 April 2026, chaired by the Secretary-General of the Ministry of Public Health and Prevention, was devoted to modernising the patient medical record, with HISP Rwanda supporting the implementation of a patient-centred Dossier Médical Électronique; no pilot site, budget or timetable is stated.

HISP Rwanda states that the electronic medical record initiative is led by the Ministry of Public Health and Prevention, whose Secretary-General chaired the meeting of 15 April 2026, with HISP Rwanda acting as technical assistant.

systems.owner: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Prévention, with HISP Rwanda as technical assistant
systems.tiers: not stated; planned, not yet in use
